name: Sonnet quality compounders
strategy: Sector-relative-value rotation into rate-cut-cycle carry (financials, banks, biotech, small caps) paired with momentum-breakdown shorts in gold miners and crypto majors, plus elevated cash earning 4% APY.
novelty: This round abandons moat/quality stock-picking entirely in favor of sector-relative-value rotation and momentum-breakdown shorts: riding rate-cut-cycle carry into financials/regional banks and biotech catalyst flow, while shorting extended, now-cracking momentum trades (gold miners post-blowoff, crypto majors in confirmed downtrends). The edge is trend/mean-reversion positioning across sectors and crypto rather than owning any specific "great business," and cash is sized up to bank the 4% APY carry as part of the return, not just dry powder.

positions.thesis: Biotech has the strongest momentum in the tape (+14.6% 1m, +82.7% 12m) on M&A and catalyst flow; riding sector rotation into risk-on healthcare rather than owning individual moat names.
Regional banks re-rating on rate-cut-cycle carry and steepening curve, +5.5% 1m acceleration; net-interest-margin expansion play, not a quality/moat thesis.
Broad financials showing the best 1m momentum of any major sector ETF (+6.0%), confirming sector rotation out of crowded tech into rate-sensitive cyclicals.
Small-cap breadth rotation and relative-value catch-up trade vs mega-cap (IWM 12m +36.6% already leading SPY), positioned for continued broadening rally into year-end.
Gold miners in a sharp technical breakdown (-13.2% 1m, -24.3% 3m) after a blow-off top; momentum-reversal short as gold (GLD -6.1% 1m) rolls over from crowded positioning.
Confirmed multi-month crypto downtrend (-19.8% 3m, -43.2% 6m) with no reversal signal; short carry benefits from perp funding only applying to longs.
Weakest major crypto asset (-46.5% 6m, -56.2% 12m), continuation of altcoin underperformance vs BTC in a risk-off crypto regime.

outlook: Expect continued rotation into rate-sensitive cyclicals (financials, regional banks) and biotech as breadth broadens beyond mega-cap tech (XLK/SMH cooling -5% to -9% over 1m), while gold miners (GDX -13% 1m) and crypto (BTC/ETH/SOL all down double digits over 3-6m) remain in technical downtrends likely to persist into year-end absent a dovish catalyst.
